model: tau_yaw = I_eff * yaw_acceleration + d_linear * yaw_rate + d_quadratic * abs(yaw_rate) * yaw_rate + bias

method.input: M1, M2, M6, and M7 single-motor +/-5%, +/-7.5%, and +/-10% records; active plus one-second neutral-after portions
method.force_reconstruction: The measured stable-tail RPM of each trial is inserted into the disabled historical FinsSim signed-quadratic load-cell prior; reconstructed torque is applied only while the selected-motor command is nonzero because transition RPM telemetry contains DSHOT outliers.
method.moment_reconstruction: tau_yaw = CAD yaw moment arm * reconstructed signed force
method.fit: nonnegative active-set least squares on dynamics integrated over overlapping 0.50 s windows; bias unconstrained

excluded_trials.M6_p0075: 98.7% repeated yaw-rate samples and zero yaw-rate excursion

limitations: Absolute force was not measured on the current vehicle.
The vehicle was tethered, so external tether torque can bias inertia and damping.
Five trials were excluded because the IMU yaw-rate field repeated abnormally.
Low yaw rate cannot identify a physically absent quadratic damping term.

confidence.linear_yaw_damping: medium-low; stable across windows and close to the historical 0.3025 N*m/(rad/s) prior
